Harness.description: The coding agent CLI that runs an agent.

OnChange.description:
`tell`: a resumed shared session's first prompt names what changed in its agent. `fresh`: the
task starts a new session instead.

oneOf.description: Claude Code's `--permission-mode` no longer takes `default`, its older name for `manual`.

Permissions.description: Claude Code's own `permissions` settings, so a person can copy rules across.

allow.description: Claude Code permission rules the run allows, such as `Bash(cargo test:*)`.

defaultMode.description: The run's `--permission-mode`, not a setting: Claude's flag outranks every settings file.

deny.description: Claude Code permission rules the run denies, such as `Bash(git push:*)`.

Session.description: `per-task`: one conversation per task. `shared`: one conversation across tasks, such as a lead.

description:
The frontmatter of `agents/<name>/agent.md`: who runs a model step. The Markdown after it is
the agent's instructions.

compactAt.description: The context size, in tokens, past which the daemon compacts the conversation between turns.

description.description: One line on what the agent does.

disk.description: What a runner keeps free on disk for a run of this agent, past its floor, in bytes.

effort.description: The harness's reasoning effort, such as `high`; the harness default when unset.

harness.description: The coding agent CLI that runs it.

idleCompactAt.description:
The context size, in tokens, past which the daemon compacts a shared session left idle
for 55 minutes, before its prompt cache expires. Unset, it never compacts an idle session.

mcpServers.description: The MCP servers the run gets, by name.

memory.description: What a runner must have free to admit a run of this agent, in bytes.

model.description: The harness's model name, such as `sonnet`; the harness default when unset.

onChange.description: What a resumed shared session does when the agent changed since it started.

runner.description: The runner it runs on, by Tailscale hostname, or `any`.

title: agent.md frontmatter
